exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who is Simba? Who is Nala?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Simba kim? Nala kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  Ikkita sher bolasi yog'och ustida yotibdi:

     A — och rangli, ko'kragi oq, boshi
         SILLIQ (tepasida tik soch yo'q)
     B — to'qroq, boshining tepasida TIK
         SOCh (tuft) bor, og'zi ochiq


JAVOBLAR:

  A = NALA
  B = SIMBA


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  ⚠ SIMBANING ENG ANIQ BELGISI —
  boshining tepasidagi TIK SOCh (yolining
  boshlanishi).

  Simba — ERKAK sher bolasi, kelajakda
  yoli (mane) o'sadi. Rasmda B da bu tik
  soch aniq ko'rinadi.

  Nala — URG'OChI sher bolasi. Urg'ochi
  sherlarda YOL BO'LMAYDI, shuning uchun
  uning boshi silliq.


FILM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  Disney multfilmi (1994), Afrika
  savannasida bo'lib o'tadi.

  Simba — qirol Mufasaning o'g'li. Amakisi
  Skar Mufasani o'ldiradi va Simbani
  quvg'in qiladi. Simba Timon va Pumbaa
  bilan o'sadi, keyin qaytib kelib
  taxtni tiklaydi.


⚠ 4-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  'a MANE' = sher yoli (bo'yindagi uzun
  soch)

  Faqat ERKAK sherlarda bo'ladi — bu
  1-mashqning kaliti!


ISMLARNING MA'NOSI (suahili tilida):

  SIMBA = sher
  NALA = sovg'a
  RAFIKI = do'st
  PUMBAA = beparvo
  ⚠ Filmdagi ko'p ismlar SUAHILI tilidan
  (Sharqiy Afrika tili).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lion      = sher
  a lioness   = urg'ochi sher
  a cub       = yirtqich hayvon bolasi
  a mane      = yol
  a king      = qirol
  Swahili     = suahili tili

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the animals you see in the film.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI HAYVON — BEShTASI FILMDA BOR:

  ✓ monkeys    (maymunlar)
  ✗ dogs       (itlar)
  ✓ zebras     (zebralar)
  ✗ crocodiles (timsohlar)
  ✗ goats      (echkilar)
  ✓ lions      (sherlar)
  ✓ elephants  (fillar)
  ✗ deer       (kiyiklar)
  ✓ giraffes   (jirafalar)
  ✗ dolphins   (delfinlar)
  ✗ tigers     (yo'lbarslar)
  ✗ horses     (otlar)


⚠ KITOB JAVOBLARNI BOSMAGAN — bu javoblar
filmga asoslangan.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 ✓ MONKEYS — Rafiki (mandril maymun) —
   filmning muhim personaji.

 ✓ ZEBRAS — 'Circle of Life' ochilish
   sahnasida ko'rinadi.

 ✓ LIONS — butun film sherlar haqida
   (Simba, Nala, Mufasa, Skar, Sarabi).

 ✓ ELEPHANTS — 'Circle of Life' sahnasida;
   yana FILLAR QABRISTONI ('the elephants'
   graveyard') — 3-mashqning 2-bandi.

 ✓ GIRAFFES — 'Circle of Life' sahnasida.


⚠ NEGA QOLGANLARI YO'Q:

 ✗ TIGERS — yo'lbarslar OSIYODA yashaydi,
   Afrikada emas! Bu — geografik tuzoq.

 ✗ DEER — kiyiklar ham Afrika savannasida
   yashamaydi (u yerda antilopalar,
   gazellalar bor).

 ✗ HORSES — otlar yovvoyi savannada yo'q;
   ZEBRA bor (o'xshash, lekin boshqa
   hayvon).

 ✗ DOLPHINS — delfinlar DENGIZDA yashaydi.
   Film savannada bo'lib o'tadi.

 ✗ DOGS va GOATS — uy hayvonlari, yovvoyi
   savannada yo'q.
   (Filmda GIYENALAR bor — itga o'xshaydi,
    lekin it EMAS!)

 ✗ CROCODILES — filmda timsoh ko'rinmaydi.
   ⚠ Bu bandda to'liq ishonch yo'q, chunki
   film uzun; lekin timsoh muhim sahnada
   uchramaydi.


⚠ UChTA GEOGRAFIK TUZOQ:

  TIGER — Osiyo hayvoni (Afrikada YO'Q)
  DEER — Yevropa/Osiyo/Amerika
  DOLPHIN — dengiz hayvoni

  Kitob ataylab BOShQA QIT'A hayvonlarini
  qo'ygan.


⚠ 'HYENAS' — RO'YXATDA YO'Q, LEKIN FILMDA
BOR:

  Giyenalar — Skarning yordamchilari
  (3-mashqning 3-bandi).

  Kitob ularni ro'yxatga kiritmagan.


KO'PLIK ShAKLLARI:
  monkey → monkeys
  zebra → zebras
  giraffe → giraffes
  ⚠ deer → DEER (o'zgarmaydi!)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a monkey    = maymun
  a zebra     = zebra
  a crocodile = timsoh
  a goat      = echki
  an elephant = fil
  a deer      = kiyik (ko'pligi ham 'deer')
  a giraffe   = jirafa
  a dolphin   = delfin
  a tiger     = yo'lbars
  a hyena     = giyena

exercises.explanationUz:
BESh GAP — HAMMASI NOTO'G'RI:


 1  ✗ 'Scar SAVES Mufasa.'
    ✓ 'Scar KILLS Mufasa.'

    (Skar Mufasani QUTQARMAYDI —
     O'LDIRADI.)

    ⚠ 'save' (qutqarmoq) ↔ 'kill'
    (o'ldirmoq) — to'liq ZID.


 2  ✗ 'Simba and Nala go to the GIRAFFE'S
       graveyard.'
    ✓ 'Simba and Nala go to the ELEPHANTS'
       graveyard.'

    (Jirafalar emas, FILLAR qabristoni.)

    ⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI ham o'zgaradi:
       'the GIRAFFE'S' (birlik)
       'the ELEPHANTS'' (ko'plik —
        apostrof '-s' DAN KEYIN!)


 3  ✗ 'Scar and the hyenas are NICE
       animals.'
    ✓ 'Scar and the hyenas are BAD/EVIL
       animals.'

    (Ular filmning YOMON personajlari.)

    ⚠ 'nice' ↔ 'bad', 'evil', 'nasty',
    'cruel'.


 4  ✗ 'Zazu is a FISH.'
    ✓ 'Zazu is a BIRD.'

    (Zazu — qush, aniqrog'i 'a hornbill'
     (shoxburun).)

    ⚠ 4-mashq bilan bog'liq: qushda BEAK
    (tumshuq) va FEATHER (pat) bor,
    sherda esa yo'q!


 5  ✗ 'Pumbaa and Timon are Simba's
       PARENTS.'
    ✓ 'Pumbaa and Timon are Simba's
       FRIENDS.'

    (Simbaning ota-onasi — MUFASA va
     SARABI.)

    ⚠ Pumbaa — cho'chqa (warthog),
      Timon — surikat (meerkat).
      Ular sher bo'la olmaydi!


⚠ 2-BANDDAGI EGALIK — DIQQAT:

  BIRLIK ot:
     'the giraffE'S graveyard'
     (apostrof + s)

  KO'PLIK ot ('-s' bilan tugagan):
     'the elephantS' graveyard'
     (apostrof '-s' DAN KEYIN, yana 's'
      qo'shilmaydi)

  Bu — 85-betdagi 'Mary Poppins'' bilan bir
  xil qoida.


⚠ 5-BANDDAGI EGALIK:
  'SIMBA'S parents/friends'
  Ism '-a' bilan tugagan → apostrof + s.


TUZATISh QOLIPI:

  'No, Scar doesn't SAVE Mufasa. He KILLS
   him.'
  'No, they don't go to the GIRAFFE'S
   graveyard. They go to the ELEPHANTS'
   graveyard.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to save     = qutqarmoq
  to kill     = o'ldirmoq
  a graveyard = qabriston
  a hyena     = giyena
  evil        = yovuz
  a hornbill  = shoxburun (qush)
  parents     = ota-ona
  a warthog   = cho'chqa (Afrika)
  a meerkat   = surikat

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the parts of a lion's body.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ SO'Z — BEShTASI SHERGA TEGIShLI:

  ✓ mane    (yol)
  ✓ tail    (dum)
  ✗ horn    (shox)
  ✓ paw     (panja)
  ✗ beak    (tumshuq)
  ✗ feather (pat)
  ✗ hoof    (tuyoq)
  ✓ claw    (tirnoq)
  ✓ fur     (jun, mo'yna)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 ✓ MANE (yol) — sherning eng mashhur
   belgisi!
   ⚠ Faqat ERKAK sherlarda bo'ladi —
   1-mashqning kaliti.

 ✓ TAIL (dum) — sherda uzun dum bor,
   uchida junli popuk.

 ✓ PAW (panja) — mushuksimonlarning
   yumshoq panjasi.

 ✓ CLAW (tirnoq) — panja ichidagi o'tkir
   tirnoq. Sher uni yashira oladi.

 ✓ FUR (jun) — sherning tanasi jun bilan
   qoplangan.


⚠ NEGA QOLGANLARI YO'Q:

 ✗ HORN (shox) — kiyik, echki, karkidon,
   sigirda bo'ladi. Sherda YO'Q.

 ✗ BEAK (tumshuq) — QUShDA bo'ladi.
   ⚠ 3-mashqning 4-bandi: 'Zazu is a BIRD'
   — tumshuq undA bor!

 ✗ FEATHER (pat) — QUShDA bo'ladi.
   ⚠ 3-nazorat testining 2-mashqi:
   'Have mice got FEATHERS?'

 ✗ HOOF (tuyoq) — OT, ZEBRA, sigirda
   bo'ladi.
   ⚠ 'hoof' ning ko'pligi — HOOVES
   (noto'g'ri ko'plik!).


⚠ HAYVON QISMLARI BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  SHER (mushuksimon):
     mane, tail, paw, claw, fur, whiskers

  QUSh:
     beak, feather, wing, claw
     (⚠ 'claw' qushda ham bor!)

  OT / ZEBRA:
     hoof (hooves), tail, mane
     (⚠ otda ham 'mane' bor — bo'yindagi
      soch!)

  KIYIK / ECHKI / KARKIDON:
     horn


⚠ ENG NOZIK IKKI SO'Z:

  'CLAW' — sherda ham, qushda ham bor.
  'MANE' — sherda ham, otda ham bor!

  Lekin bu mashqda faqat SHER haqida
  so'ralgan, shuning uchun ikkalasi ham ✓.


DIQQAT — 'FUR' SANALMAYDIGAN:
  'fur' = jun, mo'yna

  'The lion has thick FUR.'  ✓
  'furs' — mo'ynali kiyimlar (boshqa
     ma'no)


DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR:
  hoof → HOOVES
  (o'xshash: leaf → leaves, wolf → wolves,
   knife → knives)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mane      = yol
  a tail      = dum
  a horn      = shox
  a paw       = panja
  a beak      = tumshuq
  a feather   = pat
  a hoof (hooves) = tuyoq(lar)
  a claw      = tirnoq
  fur         = jun, mo'yna
  whiskers    = mo'ylov (mushukda)

tasks.whyUz:
✓ Sherning ENG MASHHUR belgisi!

⚠ Faqat ERKAK sherlarda bo'ladi — bu
1-mashqning kaliti (Simbada bor, Nalada
yo'q).

⚠ Otda ham 'mane' bor (bo'yindagi soch).

✓ Sherda uzun dum bor, uchida junli popuk.

Bu — sherni boshqa mushuksimonlardan
ajratadigan belgi.

✗ Shox KIYIK, ECHKI, KARKIDON, SIGIRda
bo'ladi.

Sherda — YIRTQICH hayvonda — shox yo'q.
Uning quroli TIRNOQ va TISH.

✓ Mushuksimonlarning yumshoq panjasi.

1-mashqdagi rasmda ikkala sher bolasining
panjalari aniq ko'rinadi.

✗ Tumshuq QUSHDA bo'ladi.

⚠ 3-mashqning 4-bandi: 'Zazu is a BIRD' —
tumshuq UNDA bor, sherda yo'q!

✗ Pat QUSHDA bo'ladi.

⚠ 3-nazorat testining 2-mashqi ham shu
haqida edi: 'Have mice got FEATHERS?'

Sherda pat emas, JUN (fur) bor.

✗ Tuyoq OT, ZEBRA, SIGIRda bo'ladi.

⚠ 'hoof' ning ko'pligi — HOOVES (noto'g'ri
ko'plik).
O'xshash: leaf → leaves, wolf → wolves,
knife → knives.

✓ Panja ichidagi O'TKIR tirnoq.

Sher uni YASHIRA oladi (mushuk kabi).

⚠ 'claw' QUSHDA ham bor — lekin bu mashqda
faqat sher haqida so'ralgan.

✓ Sherning tanasi JUN bilan qoplangan.

⚠ 'fur' — SANALMAYDIGAN:
'The lion has thick FUR.' ✓
('furs' — mo'ynali kiyimlar, boshqa ma'no)

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the following can a lion do?  jump, roar, run fast, climb, fly, swim, play tennis, dance
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ HARAKAT — BEShTASINI QILA OLADI:

  ✓ jump      (sakramoq)
  ✓ roar      (o'kirmoq)
  ✓ run fast  (tez yugurmoq)
  ✓ climb     (tirmashmoq)
  ✗ fly       (uchmoq)
  ✓ swim      (suzmoq)
  ✗ play tennis (tennis o'ynamoq)
  ✗ dance     (raqsga tushmoq)


NAMUNA JAVOB:

  'A lion can JUMP, ROAR, RUN FAST, CLIMB
   and SWIM. It can't FLY, PLAY TENNIS or
   DANCE.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Sher sakray oladi, o'kira oladi, tez
   yugura oladi, tirmasha oladi va suza
   oladi. U ucha olmaydi, tennis o'ynay
   olmaydi va raqsga tusha olmaydi.'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 ✓ JUMP — sher baland va uzoqqa sakraydi
   (ov qilishda).

 ✓ ROAR — sherning o'kirigi 8 km dan
   eshitiladi!
   ⚠ 'to ROAR' = o'kirmoq (sher, yo'lbars)
   Boshqa hayvon ovozlari:
      a dog BARKS (huradi)
      a cat MIAOWS (miyovlaydi)
      a cow MOOS (mo'yraydi)

 ✓ RUN FAST — sher soatiga 80 km gacha
   yuguradi.

 ✓ CLIMB — sher daraxtga tirmasha oladi
   (mushuksimonlar shunday).

 ✓ SWIM — sherlar suzishni biladi
   (yoqtirmasa ham).


⚠ NEGA QOLGANLARI YO'Q:

 ✗ FLY — sherda QANOT (wings) yo'q.
   ⚠ 3-nazorat testining 1-mashqi:
   'Penguins have got wings, but they can't
    FLY.'

 ✗ PLAY TENNIS — bu ODAM mashg'uloti.

 ✗ DANCE — bu ham odam mashg'uloti.
   (Filmda hayvonlar raqsga tushadi, lekin
    bu MULTFILM — haqiqiy sher raqsga
    tushmaydi!)


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — 'CAN' + ASOSIY ShAKL:

  'A lion CAN JUMP.'     ✓
  'A lion CAN JUMPS.'    ✗
  'A lion CAN TO JUMP.'  ✗

  Inkori: 'It CAN'T FLY.'

  ⚠ Ro'yxatni sanashda:
     'It can jump, roar, run fast, climb
      AND swim.'
     (oxirgisidan oldin 'and')

     Inkorda 'OR':
     'It can't fly, play tennis OR dance.'
     (inkorda 'and' emas, 'or'!)


⚠ INKORDA 'OR' — MUHIM QOIDA:

  TASDIQ: A, B and C
  INKOR:  A, B or C

  'I like tea, coffee AND milk.'
  'I don't like tea, coffee OR milk.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to jump     = sakramoq
  to roar     = o'kirmoq
  to climb    = tirmashmoq
  to swim     = suzmoq
  to bark     = hurmoq (it)
  to miaow    = miyovlamoq (mushuk)
  wings       = qanotlar

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who is Timon? Who is Pumbaa?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Timon kim? Pumbaa kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  Sharsharalar oldida yog'och ustida uchta
  personaj yurib bormoqda:

     • Chapda — kichik SHER (Simba)
     • O'rtada — KATTA, semiz hayvon,
       dumi tik ko'tarilgan
     • O'ngda — KIChIK, ozg'in, TIK TURGAN
       hayvon


JAVOBLAR:

  PUMBAA = o'rtadagi KATTA hayvon
           (cho'chqa — a warthog)

  TIMON = o'ngdagi KIChIK, ozg'in hayvon
          (surikat — a meerkat)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  ⚠ O'LChAM eng aniq belgi:

     PUMBAA — KATTA va SEMIZ
        (9-mashqning 3-bandi: 'as FAT as a
         PIG' — bu aynan Pumbaa haqida!)

     TIMON — KIChIK va OZG'IN, ikki oyoqda
        tik turadi (surikatlar shunday
        turadi)


PERSONAJLAR HAQIDA:

  PUMBAA — 'a warthog' (Afrika yovvoyi
     cho'chqasi). Mehribon, sodda, biroz
     beparvo.
     ⚠ 'Pumbaa' suahili tilida 'beparvo,
     sodda' degani.

  TIMON — 'a meerkat' (surikat, Afrika
     kichik hayvoni). Aqlli, gapdon,
     rahbarlik qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

  Ikkalasi Simbani cho'lda topib oladi va
  o'stiradi. Ular unga 'HAKUNA MATATA'
  falsafasini o'rgatadi (8-mashq).


⚠ 3-MAShQNING 5-BANDI BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  'Pumbaa and Timon are Simba's PARENTS.'
  → XATO! Ular Simbaning DO'STLARI.

  Ular sher emas — cho'chqa va surikat.


DIQQAT — 'A WARTHOG':
  'a warthog' = Afrika yovvoyi cho'chqasi
  ('wart' = so'gal, 'hog' = cho'chqa)

  Oddiy cho'chqa — 'a pig'.


DIQQAT — 'A MEERKAT':
  'a meerkat' = surikat (Afrika cho'lida
  yashaydigan kichik hayvon)

  Ular ORQA OYOQDA TIK turib atrofni
  kuzatadi — rasmda Timon ham shunday
  turgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a warthog   = Afrika yovvoyi cho'chqasi
  a pig       = cho'chqa
  a meerkat   = surikat
  a waterfall = sharshara
  a log       = yog'och bo'lagi

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the things that Pumbaa and Timon eat.
exercises.instructionUz: Pumbaa va Timon nima yeyishini belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI NARSA — ASOSIYSI BITTASI:

  ✗ berries  (rezavorlar)
  ✗ meat     (go'sht)
  ✗ honey    (asal)
  ✗ fish     (baliq)
  ✓ insects  (hasharotlar)
  ✗ apples   (olmalar)


⚠ ASOSIY JAVOB — INSECTS:

  'HAKUNA MATATA' qo'shig'ida Timon va
  Pumbaa Simbaga HASHAROT yeyishni
  o'rgatadi:

     qurtlar (grubs), qo'ng'izlar
     (beetles), chumolilar (ants)

  Timonning mashhur gapi:
     'Slimy, yet satisfying.'
     (Shilimshiq, lekin to'ydiradi.)


⚠ NEGA 'MEAT' EMAS — ENG MUHIM NUQTA:

  Simba SHER — u tabiatan GO'ShT yeydi.
  Lekin Timon va Pumbaa unga go'sht
  o'rniga HASHAROT yeyishni o'rgatadi.

  Bu — filmning muhim g'oyasi: Simba o'z
  tabiatidan uzoqlashadi.

  Film oxirida u qaytib kelib, o'z
  o'rnini topadi.


QOLGANLARI NEGA YO'Q:

 ✗ HONEY (asal) — asalni AYIQ yoki odam
   yeydi; filmda bunday sahna yo'q.

 ✗ FISH (baliq) — filmda baliq ovlash
   sahnasi yo'q.

 ✗ APPLES (olmalar) — olma Afrika
   savannasida o'smaydi.

 ⚠ BERRIES (rezavorlar) — bu bandda TO'LIQ
   ISHONCh YO'Q. Surikat va cho'chqa
   tabiatda meva ham yeydi, lekin filmda
   ochiq ko'rsatilmagan. Kitob javobni
   bosmagan.


⚠ SANALADIGAN / SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda):
     berries, insects, apples

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     meat, honey

  IKKALASI ham:
     fish ('a fish' = bitta baliq;
           'fish' = baliq go'shti)

  ⚠ 'fish' ning ko'pligi — FISH
  (o'zgarmaydi, 'deer' kabi).


DIQQAT — 'AN INSECT':
  'an insect' = hasharot
  'a bug' = qo'ng'iz, hasharot (so'zlashuv)
  'a grub' = qurt (hasharot lichinkasi)


DIQQAT — 'A BERRY':
  'a berry' → 'berrIES' (undosh + y →
  i + es)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a berry (berries) = rezavor(lar)
  meat        = go'sht
  honey       = asal
  an insect   = hasharot
  a bug       = qo'ng'iz
  a grub      = qurt
  slimy       = shilimshiq
  satisfying  = to'ydiradigan

exercises.instructionEn: What is Pumbaa and Timon's motto?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB: A — HAKUNA MATATA


'HAKUNA MATATA' NIMA DEGANI:

  Bu — SUAHILI tilidagi ibora (Sharqiy
  Afrika tili).

     hakuna = yo'q
     matata = muammolar

  Ya'ni: 'MUAMMO YO'Q!' / 'Xavotir olma!'

  Inglizchada: 'No worries!'


QO'ShIQDAGI TA'RIF:

  'Hakuna Matata! What a wonderful phrase!
   Hakuna Matata! Ain't no passing craze!
   It means NO WORRIES for the rest of your
   days.'

  = 'Hakuna Matata! Qanday ajoyib ibora!
     Bu umringizning qolgan kunlari uchun
     XAVOTIR YO'Q degani.'


⚠ B va C — HAZIL VARIANTLARI:

  B  'Hakuna TOMATO' (pomidor)
  C  'Hakuna POTATO' (kartoshka)

  Kitob ataylab OVOZI O'XShASh, lekin
  kulgili so'zlarni qo'ygan:

     maTAta / toMAto / poTAto

  Bularning ma'nosi yo'q — faqat qofiya.


⚠ 'A MOTTO' NIMA:

  'a motto' = shior, hayot qoidasi

  Ko'pligi: MOTTOES yoki MOTTOS
  (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri)

  Masalan:
     'My motto is: never give up.'
     (Mening shiorim: hech qachon taslim
      bo'lma.)


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI — DIQQAT:

  'Pumbaa and Timon'S motto'

  ⚠ IKKI odam BIRGALIKDA egalik qilsa,
  faqat OXIRGISIGA apostrof qo'yiladi:

     'Pumbaa and Timon'S motto'  ✓
        (bitta umumiy shior)
     'Pumbaa'S and Timon'S mottoes'
        (har birining alohida shiori)

  Coursebook 113-bet, 3-mashq: 'David'S and
  Sandra'S memories' — u yerda HAR BIRIDA
  o'z xotirasi bor edi!


FILMDAGI O'RNI:

  Timon va Pumbaa Simbani cho'lda topib
  olishadi. Simba otasining o'limidan
  aybdor his qiladi.

  Ular unga 'Hakuna Matata' falsafasini
  o'rgatadi: o'tmishni unut, xavotir olma.

  ⚠ Lekin film oxirida Simba tushunadi:
  o'tmishdan qochib bo'lmaydi, unga duch
  kelish kerak.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a motto     = shior
  worries     = xavotirlar
  No worries! = Xavotir olma!
  a phrase    = ibora
  a tomato    = pomidor
  a potato    = kartoshka

pomidor, potato = kartoshka). Kitob ataylab
OVOZI O'XSHASH so'zlarni qo'ygan:
maTAta / toMAto / poTAto.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the similes below with a word from the box: fat, strong, sly, brave, quiet
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi o'xshatishlarni quti ichidagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta so'z):
  fat, strong, sly, brave, quiet


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  as QUIET as a mouse
  2  as SLY as a fox
  3  as FAT as a pig
  4  as STRONG as an elephant
  5  as BRAVE as a horse


TARJIMASI:
  1  sichqondek jim
  2  tulkidek ayyor
  3  cho'chqadek semiz
  4  fildek kuchli
  5  otdek jasur


⚠ 5-BANDDA KITOBNING G'ALATI JUFTLIGI:

  Qutida 5 ta so'z, 5 ta bo'sh joy bor.
  To'rttasi TABIIY turg'un o'xshatish
  beradi:

     as QUIET as a mouse   ✓ (juda mashhur)
     as SLY as a fox       ✓ (juda mashhur)
     as FAT as a pig       ✓ (mashhur)
     as STRONG as an elephant ✓

  Lekin oxirgisi 'as BRAVE as a HORSE'
  bo'lib qoladi — bu ingliz tilida TURG'UN
  o'xshatish EMAS!

  ⚠ TABIIY JUFTLIKLAR:
     'as STRONG as a HORSE'  (otdek kuchli)
     'as BRAVE as a LION'    (sherdek jasur)

  Kitob 'strong' ni FILGA bergani uchun
  OTGA 'brave' qolgan.

  ⚠ Javob shunday, lekin buni TURG'UN
  IBORA deb yodlamang!


O'XShATISh QOLIPI:

  'as + [SIFAT] + as + a/an + [OT]'

  ⚠ Birinchi 'as' — sifatdan OLDIN
  ⚠ Ikkinchi 'as' — otdan OLDIN

  'as quiet AS a mouse'  ✓
  'as quiet like a mouse' ✗


⚠ ARTIKL — 'A' yoki 'AN':

  as ... as A mouse   (undosh)
  as ... as A fox     (undosh)
  as ... as A pig     (undosh)
  as ... as AN elephant (UNLI!)
  as ... as A horse   (undosh)

  ⚠ Kitob 4-bandda 'AN' ni allaqachon
  bosgan — bu ISHORA! Demak javob unli
  tovushdan boshlanmaydi, balki ot 'e'
  bilan boshlanadi.


BOShQA MASHHUR INGLIZ O'XShATIShLARI:

  as busy as a bee        (asalaridek band)
  as blind as a bat       (ko'rshapalakdek
                           ko'r)
  as free as a bird       (qushdek erkin)
  as slow as a snail      (shilliqqurtdek
                           sekin)
  as white as snow        (qordek oq)
  as cold as ice          (muzdek sovuq)
  as light as a feather   (patdek yengil)


O'ZBEKChA O'XShATIShLAR BILAN
SOLIShTIRISh:

  as sly as a fox    → tulkidek ayyor ✓
     (ikki tilda BIR XIL!)
  as quiet as a mouse → sichqondek jim ✓
     (bir xil)
  as strong as a horse → otdek kuchli ✓
     (bir xil)

  Ko'p o'xshatishlar ikki tilda ham bir xil
  hayvon bilan!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a simile    = o'xshatish
  sly         = ayyor
  quiet       = jim, sokin
  brave       = jasur
  a fox       = tulki
  a mouse     = sichqon
  a bee       = asalari
  a bat       = ko'rshapalak
  a snail     = shilliqqurt

tasks.whyUz:
'as QUIET as a mouse' — juda MASHHUR turg'un
o'xshatish.

Sichqon ovozsiz yuradi.

⚠ O'zbekchada ham AYNAN shunday: 'sichqondek
jim'.

'as SLY as a fox' — juda MASHHUR turg'un
o'xshatish.

'sly' = ayyor, hiylagar.

⚠ O'zbekchada ham AYNAN shunday: 'tulkidek
ayyor'.

'as FAT as a pig' — mashhur o'xshatish.

⚠ 6-mashq bilan bog'liq: PUMBAA — cho'chqa
(warthog), u KATTA va SEMIZ.

'as STRONG as an elephant' — fil eng kuchli
quruqlik hayvoni.

⚠ Kitob 'AN' ni allaqachon bosgan (elephant
unli bilan boshlanadi) — bu ISHORA.

⚠ Diqqat: 'as STRONG as a HORSE' ham mashhur
— lekin bu yerda 'strong' filga ketgan.

⚠ KITOBNING G'ALATI JUFTLIGI!

Qolgan yagona so'z → BRAVE. Lekin
'as BRAVE as a HORSE' ingliz tilida TURG'UN
o'xshatish EMAS.

TABIIY juftliklar:
  'as STRONG as a HORSE' (otdek kuchli)
  'as BRAVE as a LION' (sherdek jasur)

Kitob 'strong' ni filga bergani uchun otga
'brave' qolgan. Buni turg'un ibora deb
YODLAMANG!

exercises.instructionEn: Write a paragraph about your favourite animal. Mention: What it looks like, where it lives, what it eats and what it can do.
exercises.instructionUz: Sevimli hayvoningiz haqida bir paragraf yozing. Quyidagilarni ayting: u qanday ko'rinishga ega, qayerda yashaydi, nima yeydi va nima qila oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI — o'zingiz
yozasiz.


KITOB TO'RT NARSANI SO'RAYDI:

  1) What it LOOKS LIKE — tashqi ko'rinishi
  2) Where it LIVES — qayerda yashaydi
  3) What it EATS — nima yeydi
  4) What it CAN DO — nima qila oladi

  ⚠ Bu to'rttasi — mashqning REJASI.
  Har biriga kamida bitta gap yozing.


NAMUNA PARAGRAF (sher haqida):

──────────────────────────────────
  'My favourite animal is the lion. It is
   big and strong. It has got a long mane,
   a tail and thick fur. It has also got
   sharp claws.

   The lion lives in Africa, in the
   savanna. It eats meat — it hunts zebras
   and antelopes.

   A lion can run very fast, jump, climb
   and swim. It can also roar very loudly.
   People call it the king of the animals.'
──────────────────────────────────

  Tarjimasi:
  'Mening sevimli hayvonim — sher. U katta
   va kuchli. Uning uzun yoli, dumi va
   qalin juni bor. Yana o'tkir tirnoqlari
   ham bor.

   Sher Afrikada, savannada yashaydi. U
   go'sht yeydi — zebra va antilopalarni
   ovlaydi.

   Sher juda tez yugura oladi, sakray
   oladi, tirmasha oladi va suza oladi.
   Yana juda baland o'kira oladi. Odamlar
   uni hayvonlar shohi deb atashadi.'


HAR QISM UChUN QOLIPLAR:

 1) TAShQI KO'RINISh:
    'It is [big/small] and [strong/fast].'
    'It has got [a tail / fur / wings].'
    'It is [black/brown/grey].'

 2) QAYERDA YAShAYDI:
    'It lives in [Africa / the forest /
     the sea].'
    'It lives in [hot / cold] countries.'

 3) NIMA YEYDI:
    'It eats [meat / grass / insects /
     fish].'
    'It is a [carnivore / herbivore].'

 4) NIMA QILA OLADI:
    'It can [run / swim / fly / climb].'
    'It can't [fly / speak].'


⚠ 4 va 5-MAShQLAR — TAYYOR LUG'AT:

  4-mashqda TANA QISMLARI:
     mane, tail, paw, claw, fur, beak,
     feather, hoof, horn

  5-mashqda HARAKATLAR:
     jump, roar, run fast, climb, fly, swim

  Bularni paragrafingizda ishlating!


DIQQAT — 'IT' ISHLATILADI:

  Hayvon haqida odatda 'IT' ishlatiladi:
     'The lion... IT is big.'

  ⚠ Uy hayvoni (pet) haqida 'he/she' ham
  ishlatiladi:
     'My dog... HE is very friendly.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a paragraph = paragraf, xatboshi
  to mention  = tilga olmoq
  the savanna = savanna
  to hunt     = ovlamoq
  sharp       = o'tkir
  thick       = qalin
  loudly      = baland ovozda
  a carnivore = go'shtxo'r
  a herbivore = o'txo'r

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI OChIQ SAVOL:

 1  'Which animal would you like to have as
     a pet? A dog or a cat? Why?'
    = Qanday hayvonni uy hayvoni sifatida
      saqlashni istardingiz? It yoki
      mushuk? Nega?

 2  'How does Simba disobey his father?
     What happens?'
    = Simba otasiga qanday itoatsizlik
      qiladi? Nima bo'ladi?


1-SAVOL — OChIQ JAVOBLI:

  QOLIP:
     'I would like to have a [dog/cat]
      because ... .'
     'I'd prefer a [dog/cat] because ... .'

  NAMUNA:
     'I would like to have a dog because
      dogs are friendly and they can play
      with you. A cat is quiet but it
      doesn't always want to play.'

  ⚠ 'WOULD LIKE TO' — muloyim istak
  ('want' dan yumshoqroq).

  Foydali sifatlar:
     friendly (do'stona), playful
     (o'ynoqi), quiet (jim), independent
     (mustaqil), loyal (sodiq),
     clean (toza)


2-SAVOL — FILMGA ASOSLANGAN:

  JAVOB:

  'Mufasa tells Simba NOT TO GO to the
   elephants' graveyard. But Simba
   DISOBEYS him and goes there with Nala.

   The hyenas attack them. Mufasa comes and
   saves them.

   Later, Scar uses this to trap Simba, and
   Mufasa dies while saving his son.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Mufasa Simbaga fillar qabristoniga
   BORMASLIKNI aytadi. Lekin Simba unga
   ITOATSIZLIK qiladi va Nala bilan u yerga
   boradi.

   Giyenalar ularga hujum qiladi. Mufasa
   kelib ularni qutqaradi.

   Keyinroq Skar shundan foydalanib Simbani
   tuzoqqa tushiradi va Mufasa o'g'lini
   qutqarayotganda halok bo'ladi.'


⚠ 3-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  3-mashqning 1-bandi: 'Scar KILLS Mufasa.'
  3-mashqning 2-bandi: 'the ELEPHANTS'
     graveyard'

  Ikkalasi ham shu savolga tegishli!


DIQQAT — 'TO DISOBEY':
  'to obey' = itoat qilmoq
  'to disobey' = itoatsizlik qilmoq

  ⚠ 'dis-' — INKOR prefiksi:
     obey → disobey
     agree → disagree (rozi bo'lmaslik)
     like → dislike (yoqtirmaslik)
     appear → disappear (yo'qolmoq)


DIQQAT — 'A PET':
  'a pet' = uy hayvoni

  'to have a pet' = uy hayvoni saqlamoq
  'a pet shop' = hayvonlar do'koni


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pet       = uy hayvoni
  to obey     = itoat qilmoq
  to disobey  = itoatsizlik qilmoq
  to attack   = hujum qilmoq
  to trap     = tuzoqqa tushirmoq
  friendly    = do'stona
  loyal       = sodiq
  independent = mustaqil

items.derived: It can jump, climb AND swim.
It can't fly, play tennis OR dance.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: as quiet as a mouse, as sly as a fox, as strong as an elephant
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: sichqondek jim, tulkidek ayyor, fildek kuchli
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI 'as': birinchisi sifatdan oldin,
ikkinchisi otdan oldin.
'as quiet LIKE a mouse' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: A [hayvon] CAN + [A, B, C AND D].   /   It CAN'T + [A, B OR C].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A lion can jump, roar, climb and swim. It can't fly, play tennis or dance.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sher sakray, o'kira, tirmasha va suza oladi. U ucha, tennis o'ynay yoki raqsga tusha olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It HAS GOT + [tana qismi].   /   It IS + [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It has got a long mane, a tail and thick fur. It is big and strong.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning uzun yoli, dumi va qalin juni bor. U katta va kuchli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The lion lives in Africa, in the savanna. It eats meat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sher Afrikada, savannada yashaydi. U go'sht yeydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Hayvon haqida 'IT'; uy hayvoni haqida
'he/she' ham mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] tells [kim] NOT TO + [ASOSIY fe'l], but [ega] DISOBEYS him.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mufasa tells Simba not to go there, but Simba disobeys him.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mufasa Simbaga u yerga bormaslikni aytadi, lekin Simba unga itoatsizlik qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'tell somebody NOT TO do something' —
inkor buyruqni bilvosita aytish.
